title: Neuroimage Biomarker Identification of the Conversion of Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease.
summary: Machine-learning analysis of MRI volume, surface-area and related features predicted conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer’s disease, evaluated against longitudinal outcomes. The paper appeared in Frontiers in Neuroscience. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
ai_technology: Random-forest feature selection and multilayer perceptron
organization: MediaTek Inc.; National Cheng Kung University

evidence.tested: Machine-learning analysis of MRI volume, surface-area and related features predicted conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer’s disease, evaluated against longitudinal outcomes.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed study does not establish validation or benefit beyond its reported evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: Random-forest feature selection and a multilayer perceptron classified MCI-to-Alzheimer conversion using hippocampal morphology measures.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
